title: iARCS: Iterative Agentic RL for Controllable 3D Scene Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.06161v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Synthetic 3D scene generation is increasingly used as a data source for computer vision and embodied AI, but existing generators often optimize perceptual realism without reliably satisfying task-critical functional constraints. This mismatch limits the usefulness of synthetic data for downstream training, where accessibility, traversability, and spatial rule compliance are often essential. We present iARCS, an iterative agentic reinforcement learning framework that adapts a pretrained scene generator to natural-language task requirements. iARCS uses a two-stage strategy: universal-reward pretraining to improve physical plausibility and layout quality, followed by task-specific fine-tuning with LLM-generated reward programs that are iteratively refined from training feedback. translated_title: iARCS：用于可控3D场景生成的迭代式智能体强化学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.06161v2 公告类型：替换  摘要：合成3D场景生成越来越多地被用作计算机视觉和具身人工智能的数据源，但现有的生成器通常优化感知真实感，却无法可靠地满足任务关键的功能约束。这种不匹配限制了合成数据对下游训练的有用性，而在这些场景中，可达性、可穿越性和空间规则符合性往往至关重要。我们提出了iARCS，一个迭代式智能体强化学习框架，它将预训练的场景生成器适应于自然语言任务需求。iARCS采用两阶段策略：通用奖励预训练以提高物理合理性和布局质量，随后使用由训练反馈迭代精炼的LLM生成的奖励程序进行任务特定微调。实验表明，在可步行性、可达性和间隙聚焦任务上，约束保真度得到提升，任务特定约束优化有效，并展示了协同改进。
tldr: iARCS提出了一种迭代式智能体强化学习框架，通过通用奖励预训练和LLM生成的奖励程序微调，使预训练场景生成器能可靠满足自然语言任务的功能约束（如可穿越性、可达性等），显著提升了合成3D场景在任务关键场景中的实用性。
en_tdlr: iARCS introduces an iterative agentic reinforcement learning framework that adapts pretrained scene generators to natural-language task requirements via universal-reward pretraining and LLM-generated reward program fine-tuning, significantly improving functional constraint fidelity (e.g., walkability, reachability) in synthetic 3D scenes.
